Manipulating apps that are hidden from the list could cause crashes and all sorts of unexpected behavior. However, this feature can be useful when faulty vendor-customized ROMs does not enable all necessary system apps in work profile by default. If you continue, you are on your own.
Off: apps are not frozen on screen lock

Battery, background, link with the profile

When enabled, you\'ll be able to browse / view / pick / copy files in Gatekeeper from main profile and vice-versa, ONLY through Documents UI (named Files or Documents on your launcher) or apps with Documents UI support (they only gain temporary access to files you choose in Documents UI), while still pertaining the filesystem isolation.

A call from a number saved only in the work profile shows up as unknown in the personal call log.

Enable a fake NFC payment service in the main profile, so that the "contactless payments" option under Settings - NFC becomes enabled to allow you to choose a payment app inside the work profile. This works around an Android bug that makes it impossible to select a payment app inside the work profile if none is available in the main profile.
Comma-separated domains, e.g. .ru, .su, example.com. Warning: the work profile browser sees every matching link, including personal ones.

This cannot detect vendor task killers such as ColorOS HANS. Use the vendor battery settings too.

When the screen is locked, automatically freeze apps launched from \"Unfreeze & Launch Shortcut\".

Do NOT freeze foreground apps (with visible activity) when you lock your screen. This can be useful for apps like music players, but you\'ll need to manually freeze them through \"Batch Freeze Shortcut\" afterwards.

Off by default: freezing kills notifications from messengers, banks and government apps. It is useless if work profile traffic does not go through the VPN -- there is nothing to hide, and the apps go silent for nothing.

Android requires a one-time permission before Gatekeeper can install apps into the work profile. Enable \"Allow from this source\" in the screen that opens, then start the clone again.
Auto-copy work screenshots and camera photos

Copies new screenshots (Pictures/Screenshots) and camera photos/videos (DCIM/Camera) from the work profile into your personal gallery. Runs whenever the File Shuttle connects (e.g. you open the Files app); files are copied, not moved. Deliberate isolation hole: these two folders only, everything else stays inside the work profile.
Cannot uninstall system apps in a profile that Gatekeeper has no control of.
Cannot add shortcuts to your launcher. Please contact the developer for more information.
All apps in \"Auto Freeze\" list have been frozen successfully.

Gatekeeper needs Usage Stats permission to do this. Please enable the permission for BOTH OF THE TWO Gatekeeper apps shown in the dialog after you press \"Ok\". Failing to do so will cause this feature to not work properly.

Gatekeeper needs access to All Files for File Shuttle. Please enable the permission for BOTH OF THE TWO (Personal / Work) Gatekeeper apps shown in the dialog after you press \"Ok\".

The system share sheet cannot move files between profiles. Gatekeeper opens the file manager with access to both profiles instead.

No connection to the work profile

Gatekeeper in the work profile closed without answering. Usually it is killed there by power saving or by the vendor\'s app freezer. Exclude Gatekeeper from battery optimization and from background restrictions in both profiles, then retry.

The work profile answered but did not hand over its service, so its Gatekeeper process was most likely killed while starting. Exclude Gatekeeper from battery optimization and from background restrictions in both profiles, then retry.
The work profile cannot be reached: it is switched off, or Gatekeeper is not installed there. Turn Work Mode on and retry.
Cloning non-system apps to another profile is currently not possible on MIUI. Please clone your system\'s app store (e.g. Play Store) into the other profile and then install apps from there.

On MIUI/HyperOS, installing APKs inside a work profile often hangs on the system installer screen (a known firmware issue). Recommended: clone an app store (e.g. Play Store, RuStore or GetApps) into the work profile and install apps from there. Continue anyway?

Install a root CA (for example, the Russian Ministry of Digital Development root) into the work profile only: government sites will then open in browsers inside the profile. Most apps do not trust user-installed CAs since Android 7, and the personal profile is never touched. Android will show a persistent \"network may be monitored\" notice — that is expected.
Root certificates installed in the work profile. Tap to review or remove.

Check this fingerprint against the value published by the certificate issuer before installing. The certificate will be trusted only inside the work profile: browsers will open government sites, but most apps ignore user-installed CAs (Android 7+).
After installation Android will show a \"network may be monitored\" notice in the work profile — this is a system requirement, not a failure.

Could not read the selected file
Certificate installed in the work profile
No connection to the work profile
No certificates are installed in the work profile
Certificate removed from the work profile
A separate zone inside your phone

Gatekeeper creates an Android work profile - an isolated zone with its own data, accounts and permissions. Apps inside cannot see your personal side of the phone: not the accounts, not the files, not the contacts.

One tap freezes an app: it leaves the home screen and stops running in the background. Files cross between profiles only when you pick them.

Honest about the limits: this is isolation, not anonymity. Apps inside the profile still see the phone model and that a VPN is up, and NFC payments from the profile work only on some firmware.

Gatekeeper becomes the owner of the new profile. Inside it, it can install, remove, hide and launch apps, manage their permissions and install root certificates - into that profile only.

On the personal side it gets nothing until you turn a feature on yourself. File transfer, the VPN watcher and media copying ask for permission when you enable them, and say what it is for.

All of it is revoked in one move: delete the work profile in system settings. Personal data is untouched.
The work profile is a system feature. Where the vendor cut it down, Gatekeeper cannot work around it - so I check up front.
The profile slot is free: no other profile manager
The profile slot is taken: remove the existing work profile in system settings
%1$s: installing APKs inside the profile often hangs. Install apps from a store inside the profile instead.
Usually 10 to 30 seconds. Android is about to show its own profile-creation screen: two or three taps, and you come back here.

One system step is left. On Android 7 you have to tap the Gatekeeper notification in the shade; on newer versions the system shows its own completion screen.

If you see neither: turn off Do Not Disturb and pull the shade down. On Xiaomi and Redmi the system finish button sometimes flashes for a split second - open Settings, Accounts, and check whether the work profile was created.

This screen closes itself as soon as the profile starts answering.
The profile could not be created

Common causes: the device already has a work profile from another app or an earlier install - Android allows only one; the firmware blocks profile creation; the setup was cancelled on the system screen.\n\nWhat to do: open Settings, Accounts, remove the existing work profile and tap Retry. Removing the profile erases its apps and their data; the personal side is untouched.
